name: Brake assembly through wheel opening

original_specification.name: Brake assembly through wheel opening
original_specification.description: Two external areas target an existing wheel-well opening rather than illuminating through bodywork.

subject_scale_policy.definition: B is the maximum positive extent of the selected wheel-well region.
subject_scale_policy.origin: Selected subject bounding-box center unless an explicit per-preset aperture origin is stated.
subject_scale_policy.axes: Subject-local right-handed frame: +Z up, -Y front, +X right. Camera motion does not move the rig.
subject_scale_policy.position_and_size_units: Dimensionless multiples of B; multiply by B in millimeters exactly once when authoring.
subject_scale_policy.fit_policy: Fit once on explicit user action, then store real transforms. Do not refit per pose, frame, selected face or camera move.
subject_scale_policy.degenerate_subject_policy: Block if there is no positive finite selected-subject extent.
subject_scale_policy.normalization_policy: Source gains are resolved through CAL-LIGHT-001 at the applied physical scale; point and area source units are never assumed equivalent.

lights.visible_emitter_policy: If represented by a visible mesh, it must share this source owner and add no duplicate energy.
If represented by a visible mesh, it must share this source owner and add no duplicate energy.

locks: Require manual camera exposure locked across comparisons. This rig does not set exposure, white balance, tone mapping or output settings.
Material, CAD geometry, object pose and animation remain unchanged when applying the rig.
Resolve source and modifier clearance before authoring. Block unresolved or intersecting placements instead of silently moving geometry.
One energy owner per physical emitter. Analytic and visible mesh representations must not double-count emission.
Check every required capability before authoring or rendering. If any is unavailable, keep the scene unchanged and report the missing capability IDs.
All samples are specified_unbound: no SolidCraft runtime adapter, asset installation or renderer support is promised.

For the calibrated studio comparison, require zero unaccounted environment illumination. Preserve existing environment data; ask for an explicit compatible lighting variant rather than changing it silently.
validation: Confirm all normalized coordinates are resolved once in millimeters and all angle fields use radians.
Record the calibrated source gains, capability report, subject reference and manual-exposure camera snapshot.
Compare a clean undenoised linear render before judging fine optical details.
Bodywork and wheel components cast real shadows; reject an occluded light path instead of moving solids.

original_specification.name: Balanced Product

sampling.error_estimator: Versioned relative standard error of scene-linear luminance with a documented dark-signal floor; adapter must bind an estimator before use.
sampling.maximum_samples_action: Finish with an unconverged flag when the target is not met.
sampling.scope: Estimated Monte Carlo uncertainty for the bound estimator, not total optical error, finite-depth bias, rare-path coverage or temporal error.
sampling.stopping_rule_binding: Require a versioned pixel/tile aggregation rule and dark-signal floor before execution.

transport.roulette_policy: Compensated stochastic termination; finite depth is a declared truncation.

original_specification.budget_policy: Resolve memory and time against the selected executor; never switch devices or downgrade silently.
original_specification.baseline_compatibility: Future authoring target; resolve every field against the current executor before use.
validation: Measure convergence in dark regolith and bright metal or glass regions.
Compare raw and finished results; preserve labels, fibers and thin wires.
Report elapsed time, peak memory and incomplete quality targets.
original_specification.seed_policy: Base seed; bind a versioned frame/pixel/sample/time-stratum stream policy and record it in the render manifest.

limitations: Native fixed sampling does not assert the original convergence/error estimator.
